raw_result.summary: After registering a fake callback on the passed cancellation token, the native test still timed out at line 335 awaiting that callback. The public call completed in about 1.23s; disposal can release the fake await and unregister its callback before the cancellation source invokes it. The result is another test-ordering failure, not evidence that the timeout token remained uncancelled. Restricted build denied CSC obj write; approved native run reached product assertion.
